text.formatted:
While you have the Restrained condition, you experience the following effects.

_**Speed 0.**_ Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.

_**Attacks Affected.**_ Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.

_**Saving Throws Affected.**_ You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
